1523201.name: Blinding Wave
1523201.description: Unleashes an energy wave, dealing damage to the Nikke with the highest ATK.

1523202.name: Earth-Rending Slash
1523202.description: Performs a powerful slash that cleaves the ground, producing a shock wave and sword blast that deal damage to a single Nikke.

1523204.name: Sundering Blades
1523204.description: Launches a barrage of wing blades, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act. The wing blades can be intercepted.

1523205.name: Lacerating Wave
1523205.description: Concentrates energy and launches a projectile in the shape of a wing blade, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1523206.name: Offset Strike
1523206.description: Closes in instantly and swings her sword, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1523207.name: Shadowstrike Dance
1523207.description: Swings her sword wildly, producing a sword blast that deals damage to all Nikkes.

1523208.name: Bloody Strike
1523208.description: Stabs with her sword, piercing through cover and dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit will suffer sustained damage.

1523210.name: Void Splitter: First Form
1523210.description: Slices through space with her sheathed sword. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, the entire squad is wiped out.

1523211.name: Void Splitter: Second Form
1523211.description:
Slices through space with her sheathed sword.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while Cancel Rings are active. While the barrier is up, only Electric Code Nikkes can deal damage.
Failing to destroy the Cancel Rings will result in the entire squad being wiped out.
